;Business and economy
*[[September 2018 inter-Korean summit]], [[North Korea–South Korea relations]]
**The heads of [[Samsung]], [[Hyundai Motor Group|Hyundai]], [[SK Group|SK]] and [[LG Corporation|LG]] will attend the third [[Inter-Korean summits|Inter-Korean summit]] between [[President of South Korea|South Korean President]] [[Moon Jae-in]] and [[Supreme Leader of North Korea|North Korea]] leader [[Kim Jong-un]] in [[Pyongyang]] next week. [https://www.upi.com/Top_News/World-News/2018/09/13/South-Korean-business-leaders-to-attend-inter-Korean-summit/9631536812049/ (UPI)]
*The [[European Central Bank]] maintains its policy to halve [[Quantitative easing|monetary stimulus]] after September and end it in December 2018. However, the ECB perceives "uncertainties related to rising protectionism" as the main concern for the global economy. [http://www.dailyjournal.net/2018/09/13/eu-europe-economy-7/ (''The Daily Journal'')]

;Disasters and accidents
*[[2018 Atlantic hurricane season]]
**[[Hurricane Florence]] weakens to a category 1 storm, but "life-threatening storm surge and rainfall" to [[the Carolinas]] remain likely with tropical-storm-force winds on Thursday. [https://www.wbir.com/article/news/nation-world/hurricane-florences-winds-and-rain-begin-lashing-carolinas/507-593637357 (WBIR)], [https://www.businessinsider.com/hurricane-florence-track-evacuations-2018-9 (''Business Insider'')]
*[[Hurricane Maria#Aftermath|Aftermath of Hurricane Maria]], [[Hurricane Maria death toll controversy]]
**[[President of the United States|U.S. President]] [[Donald Trump]] denies that 3,000 people died in the [[Hurricane Maria|2017 hurricane]], advancing a number of "6 to 18 deaths", and further makes the false assertion that the [[Democratic Party (United States)|Democrats]] inflated the former number. [https://www.nbcnews.com/politics/donald-trump/trump-claims-3-000-did-not-die-puerto-rico-hurricane-n909221 (NBC News)] [https://www.npr.org/2018/09/13/647377915/trump-denies-death-toll-in-puerto-rico-falsely-claims-done-by-the-democrats (NPR)]
*[[Massachusetts gas explosions]]
**At least 40 homes are damaged and 1 person killed in [[Lawrence, Massachusetts|Lawrence]], [[Andover, Massachusetts|Andover]], and [[North Andover, Massachusetts|North Andover]], as  at least 39 [[gas explosion]]s level houses. Residents are being evacuated to neighboring towns. [http://www.foxnews.com/us/2018/09/13/massachusetts-suspected-gas-explosions-damage-or-destroy-at-least-20-homes-officials-say.html (Fox News)], [https://edition.cnn.com/2018/09/13/us/massachusetts-explosions-fires/index.html (CNN)], [https://abcnews.go.com/US/39-locations-fires-explosions-suspected-gas-leak-massachusetts/story?id=57810022 (ABC)]
*Heavy floods, following recent heavy rainfall in [[Adamawa State|Adamawa]], [[Nigeria]], kill at least 10 people and displace several hundreds more. [https://www.premiumtimesng.com/regional/nnorth-east/283424-flood-kills-10-displaces-hundreds-in-adamawa-sema.html (''Premium Times'')]
*Seven tourists are injured after a section of cliff  breaks away above [[Navagio|Shipwreck Beach]] at Navagio, on the [[Greece|Greek]] island of [[Zakynthos]], creating a minor [[tsunami]] that capsized several small boats in the cove. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-45513912 (BBC)] [https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/2018/09/13/massive-sheet-rock-sloughed-off-cliff-onto-vacationers-greek-island/?utm_term=.b2f9935a62ef (''The Washington Post'')]

;Law and crime
*[[Organized crime in Nigeria]]
**Bandits open fire at a [[village hall]], where residents gather at night to watch films, in [[Zamfara State]], [[Nigeria]]. Eleven people are killed and many more are injured. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-45508783 (BBC)]
*[[Torture during the Algerian War of Independence]]
**[[President of France|French President]] [[Emmanuel Macron]] announces the recognition that the French state systematically [[torture]]d during the 1950s–60s [[Algerian War|Algerian War of Independence]] and calls to open archives concerning those who disappeared, such as activist [[Maurice Audin]]. [https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/europe/frances-macron-admits-to-militarys-systematic-use-of-torture-in-algeria-war/2018/09/13/6b0e85cc-b729-11e8-94eb-3bd52dfe917b_story.html (''The Washington Post'')]

*[[Mass surveillance in the United Kingdom]]
**The [[European Court of Human Rights]] rules that the [[United Kingdom]] breached provisions in the [[European Convention on Human Rights]] in relation to [[mass surveillance]] practices exposed by [[United States|American]] [[whistleblower]] [[Edward Snowden]]. [https://apnews.com/4d36226beadb4a8b8d0bb58902c95af0 (AP News)]

;Politics and elections
*The Spanish [[Congress of Deputies]] approves the decree to allow the government to exhume the dictator [[Francisco Franco]]'s remains from the [[Valle de los Caídos]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-spain-politics-franco/spanish-parliament-votes-to-exhume-remains-of-dictator-franco-idUSKCN1LT2C9 (Reuters)] [https://www.nytimes.com/2018/09/13/world/europe/franco-spain-mausoleum.html (''The New York Times'')]
*[[South Sudan civil war]] 
**[[President of South Sudan]] [[Salva Kiir]] and leader of [[SPLM-IO]] [[Riek Machar]] reach a peace agreement. Other rebel factions are also expected to join a reformed government. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-45511352 (BBC)]
